name: memory-handoff
description: Turns the conversation a compaction is about to throw away into durable memories

live.title: Live
live.description: Off, every compaction writes a rehearsed row and nothing reaches the model. On, it forks and it injects.

dir.title: Data directory
dir.description: Where rows, replies and memory.sqlite are kept. Empty uses ~/.claude/memory-handoff.

sessionBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudgetUsd.description: What one session's generations may cost. Empty uses 1.00; zero or less is no ceiling.

injectK.title: Memories retrieved
injectK.description: How many memories the retrieval is asked for. Empty uses 5.

injectMaxEntries.title: Memories injected
injectMaxEntries.description: How many may go into the block. Empty uses 5.

injectMaxChars.title: Injected block ceiling
injectMaxChars.description: How large the whole block may be, in characters. Empty uses 4000.

injectTimeoutMs.title: Retrieval timeout (ms)
injectTimeoutMs.description: How long retrieval may take before the prompt goes on without it. Empty uses 2500.
